svg.title: Architectural drawing
svg.desc: Worm's-eye isometric of a groin-vaulted bay seen from below: two barrel vaults cross at right angles, their intersection forming the diagonal groins; the load gathers into the four corner piers, leaving all four sides open as arches. Source: Worm's-eye axonometric in the manner of Auguste Choisy, Histoire de l'architecture (1899, public domain). Original construction by Project Exodus.
